questions.solution: The erroneous part is **'Schools was brought'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, **'Schools were brought'** should be used instead of **'Schools was brought'.** • In the given sentence '**Schools**' is **a plural noun**. • Hence, it should be followed by **a plural helping verb.** • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.** **Correct Sentence:__** ***Schools were brought** to an abrupt standstill when the lockdown was imposed.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहां **'Schools was brought'** के बजाय **'Schools were brought'** का इस्तेमाल किया जाना चाहिए। • दिए गए वाक्य में '**Schools**' एक **plural noun **है। इसलिए, इसके बाद **plural helping verb** होनी चाहिए। • अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 4 **है। 35:Tef1, The correct answer is '**Amongst**'.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

__From__ all her birthday presents, Vanya liked the alphabetical mat the most.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**Amongst**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate substitute for the given sentence is '**Amongst**'.
 
• **Among** and **amongst** are prepositions.
 
• **'Among' **means ‘in the middle or included in a larger group of people or things’. **Among** is commonly followed by a plural noun phrase.
 
• **'Amongst'** is sometimes used as an alternative to among. It is more formal and less common.
 
• It indicates a division, choice, or differentiation involving three or more participants.
 
 
• *Example: The results show that both girls are **amongst** the top 10% of students in the whole school.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** ***Amongst** all her birthday presents, Vanya liked the alphabetical mat the most.* 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिए गए वाक्य के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प '**Amongst**' है।
 
• '**Among**' और '**amongst**' में **prepositions** हैं।
 
• '**Among**' का अर्थ है 'बीच में या लोगों या चीजों के बड़े समूह में शामिल'। 'Among' में आमतौर पर plural noun phrase होता है।
 
• '**Amongst**' में कभी-कभी बीच के विकल्प के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है। यह अधिक औपचारिक और कम सामान्य है।
 
• 
 
 
• *Example: The results show that both girls are **amongst** the top 10% of students in the whole school.*
 
 
 
• अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 1** है।

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

__As been rich,__ he can afford this expensive treatment.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Being rich'.**

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'Being rich'** should be used instead of **'As been rich'**.
 
• Starting a sentence with "**being**" is perfectly correct, as long as you're using the gerund. (Or the noun "being" as in "a celestial being.")
 
• '**Gerunds**' are verbs that became **nouns**, so they function just like any other **noun**.
 
• That includes '**being**' as the '**subject**' of a sentence. 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** **Being rich**, he can afford this expensive treatment.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है।
 
• यहां **'As been rich'** के स्थान पर** 'Being rich' **का प्रयोग करना चाहिए।
 
• जब तक आप **gerund** का उपयोग कर रहे हैं, तब तक "**being**" के साथ एक वाक्य शुरू करना पूरी तरह से सही है। (या **noun** "**being**" के रूप में **"a celestial being"** के रूप में।)
 
• '**Gerunds**' वे **verbs** हैं जो **nouns** बन गई हैं, इसलिए वे किसी भी अन्य **noun** की तरह ही कार्य करती हैं।
 
• अत: सही उत्तर** विकल्प 4 **है।
